title: Member Show Benefits Harwich Elementary PTO
bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder September 13, 2018

A member art show featuring works of the Guild of Harwich Artists will take place at the Harwich Cultural Center, 204 Sisson Road, Harwich MA. The public is invited to the opening reception on Saturday, September 15 from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM and on successive Fridays 9/21, 9/28, 10/5, and 10/12 from 11:00 AM – 2:00 PM. Art, in all media, will be available will be on display. Contributing artists, and other Guild members, will be on hand to answer questions and provide further information about upcoming Guild events and classes.

As part of the Guild’s ‘art in the community’ initiative, proceeds from the artist hanging fee will be contributed to the Harwich Elementary School Parent Teacher Organization (PTO) to further art education.  For more information about the Guild programs and events visit www.guildofharwichartists.org or email info@guildofharwichartists.org.
